subject: general
question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

242, 288, ?, 392, 450
solution:
**The logic followed here is : Double addition pattern is followed -**

 
• **First addition - Consecutive multiple of 4 is added starting from 46.**
 
• **Second addition - 4 is added subsequently.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1125ea00659d589403a60fb2b6d572c19b8ceac83daba3863689d57202a36252.png] 

Hence, **"338"** is the correct answer.
